name: 57225 · Clark, SD
findings: ZIP 57225 (Clark) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (64%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 57225 (Clark) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
67% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
